description: SUQPEB crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C52 H40 Dy4 N24 O18. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy1B (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy2B (Dy) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.183-4.183 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 141.79-141.79°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C52H40N24O18Dy4. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
